sourceFacts.fact: Pseudohypertrophy in Duchenne reflects replacement of muscle by fat and connective tissue.
Increased external bulk does not imply increased contractile strength.

layoutSpecification: Title 'Pseudohypertrophy: bulk is not strength'. Two piles of ABSTRACT FLAT SQUARE TOKENS on a desk, not tissue and not contained within a muscle-shaped outline. LEFT smaller pile: exactly EIGHT teal square tokens arranged a clean 2x4 array, heading 'More contractile material'. RIGHT larger pile: exactly FOUR teal square tokens plus EIGHT ochre square tokens in a clean 3x4 array, heading 'More replacement material'. Keep all tokens same size with straight sides, no fibres, cell shapes, stripes or lobules. Below a legend with one teal swatch 'Contractile muscle' and one ochre swatch 'Fat and fibrous replacement'. Bottom 'Token quantities are illustrative'. No calf or muscle silhouette, anatomical cross-section, histology, percentages, microscopic texture, real diagnostic stain or strength measurement. The large pile must contain fewer teal tokens despite more total tokens.
